summary: Diagnose exact L4 Source evidence bundle binding failure in run 37689932878 and correct controller-owned scheduled tenant resolution in pipeline producer binding.

diagnosis.observed_error: RuntimeError: Teaching evaluation job failed: evaluation_admission_rejected: source DatasetVersion authority rejected: exactly one source evidence bundle must bind the selected connector run
diagnosis.root_cause_analysis: In qualification run 37689932878, the PostgreSQL cache fix (PR 6320/6322) did not cause nor resolve the L4 failure. The consumer (training-session) queries GET /api/source-ingest/evidence/bundles with header X-Tenant-Id: tenant-dev, which filters bundles in PostgreSQL by payload->'metadata'->>'tenant_id' = 'tenant-dev'. On the producer side, source-ingest ran scheduled connector tw_official_pull without PANTHEON_TENANT_ID in the container environment, and connector.metadata had no explicit tenant_id. Consequently, pipeline.py resolved connector_tenant to None, omitting the tenant stamp on source records and resulting in evidence bundles stored with payload->'metadata'->>'tenant_id' as None (untenanted). When training-session queried for tenant-dev bundles, PostgreSQL returned matching_count=0 (observed_count=0 matching tenant-dev), causing _select_evidence_bundles to fail closed.
diagnosis.causal_link: Producer pipeline did not resolve tenant from authoritative persisted controller state when container environment variable PANTHEON_TENANT_ID was unset, creating an untenanted bundle invisible to tenant-scoped consumer queries.

fix.producer: In services/source_ingestion/pipeline.py, introduce _resolve_connector_tenant(connector, runtime) helper. When connector is controller-owned (reconciliation managed by persona_source_provisioning_reconciler) and env vars are unset, fall back to reading tenant_id from runtime.CONTROLLER_STATE_PATH. Apply consistently in both run_job and persist_source_evidence_refs.
fix.consumer_diagnostics: In services/training-session/source_dataset_authority.py, enhance _select_evidence_bundles failure message when matching_count != 1 with bounded, redacted diagnostics (matching_count, selected connector, run_id, observed_count, and sample bundle metadata [id, connector, run, tenant]) without exposing tokens, auth headers, or raw payload content.
fix.fail_closed_invariants: Strict single bundle requirement, exact connector/run match, tenant isolation, future timestamp rejection, and SHA-256 integrity remain strictly enforced.
